outcome: massive hemorrhage during dilatation and curettage
cohort: The study participants were 405 Type 2 cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) patients treated at Hunan Maternal and Child Health Hospital who underwent focused ultrasound ablation surgery and subsequent dilatation and curettage.
finding: The developed predictive model effectively assesses the risk of massive hemorrhage during dilatation and curettage in Type 2 cesarean scar pregnancy patients after focused ultrasound ablation surgery.
